mode: The RTX 5090 runtime component changed (v0.6.3-qwen38-5090-beta.1, the upstream-2026-09 backport), so the documented RTX 5090 container route ran against the published image from a stock clone of the promoted candidate: the inference-host half on the appliance and the macOS client half from an isolated HOME. The RTX 5090 profile gates were also re-measured through the documented tunnel on that route. The native Windows client route and the RTX 4090 route carry from v0.6.6 with reasons.

rtx5090-container-host.note: from a stock clone of the promoted candidate: the documented start block pulled ghcr.io/alphastorm/ninfer-runtime@sha256:fc244576… by digest with an empty credential store and the launcher accepted the identity it computed - binary 9afa8824, configuration 622ab621 under qwen38-5090-v0.6.3 (the deployment profile does not advance: the configuration is unchanged). The prepare block's model download hit HTTP 416 on a complete-file resume (curl 8.5 + --fail); the block now lets the byte count and checksum decide, a change measured red then green in this window.

rtx5090-macos-client.note: 10 of 10 from an isolated HOME against the published image: tool marker, Vision, nonce on --continue, a server restart from the Mac with the session continued, fail-closed with the tunnel stopped; installed client setting startup.checkUpdate read back false

rtx5090-windows-client.installed_client_setting: startup.checkUpdate = false, read back from the client the route installed
rtx5090-windows-client.note: clone substituted with the candidate commit and verified installable, as every pre-cut run is
rtx5090-windows-client.carried_from: v0.6.6: the client bytes and blocks are unchanged; the server behaviours that route checks (tool, Vision, resume, fail-closed) are a subset of what the macOS client route exercised against the new image in this window
